description: Hand-curated relevance set for LAPPATO_MCB's local _score_hit ranking. Each entry pairs a manifest-style query with a synthetic-but-plausible paper record and a 5-point human relevance rating (5 = central match, 0 = unrelated). Used by examples/validate_score.py to report Spearman rank correlation between human ratings and the deterministic local score. Intended as a small sanity-check, NOT a benchmark.

rating_scale.5: Central match — title and topic align directly with the query intent.
rating_scale.4: Strong match — query intent clearly addressed; minor terminology drift.
rating_scale.3: Partial match — touches the topic but on a different angle or at a tangent.
rating_scale.2: Weak match — shares a few keywords but addresses an unrelated problem.
